# Caroline Maguire

> Portfolio of Caroline Maguire, a senior technical writer in Cork, Ireland, specialising in developer tools, APIs, docs-as-code, and AI documentation automation.

## Overview

- [👋 Welcome](https://carolinemaymaguirecmm.github.io/carolinemaymaguirecmm/): I'm Caroline Maguire — a technical writer and product specialist focused on developer tools, embedded systems, and clear, user-focused documentation.

## Projects

- [Project focused work](https://carolinemaymaguirecmm.github.io/carolinemaymaguirecmm/projects/): This section includes hands-on technical projects, including:
- [AI Masters Project](https://carolinemaymaguirecmm.github.io/carolinemaymaguirecmm/projects/ai-masters-project/): The following notebooks were completed as part of my MSc in Software Design with Artificial Intelligence. They explore data analysis and machine learning using real-world datasets.
- [Deploy a FastAPI microservice to AWS EC2 using Uvicorn](https://carolinemaymaguirecmm.github.io/carolinemaymaguirecmm/projects/fast-dsp-microservice/deployment-guide/): This guide shows you how to deploy a FastAPI microservice to AWS EC2. The service fetches data from a third-party API, processes the response, and exposes it through a RESTful endpoint. While the API used in this example uses a free tidal data API, the same pattern can be applied to any data-driven API.
